total_weight_after_reset.meaning: totalWeight value after voters call reset in the next epoch's window
total_weight_after_reset.checkpoint: after voters reset in next epoch window

emission_cycle_removed_from_reward_flow.meaning: an entire emission cycle is permanently removed from the reward flow (not accounted to gauges' claimable)
emission_cycle_removed_from_reward_flow.checkpoint: after emission distribution for the epoch

assumptions: The checked action is the epoch emission distribution (notifyRewardAmount/distributeAll) occurring after voters reset totalWeight to zero.
The minted epoch emission is the amount that should be accounted to gauges' claimable reward flow.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether notifyRewardAmount is called directly or only via distributeAll, so the exact checked action boundary for the emission cycle is ambiguous.

limitations: The impact is modeled as a Boolean occurrence of an entire emission cycle being removed from the reward flow; the report gives no numeric magnitude for the emission cycle.
The safety relation is stated only for the scenario where totalWeight has been brought to zero by voters' reset; broader scopes are not formalized here.
